1.explanation:
•  MultiSelect/MultiSelect.mdx, docs/overview.mdx, and README.md: these define the component’s API, usage examples, and where we’ll add the new readOnly prop, its styles, and sample code for documentation and storybook.
•  MultiSelect/tools: existing helper utilities for generating stories/controls in the playground; this is where we’ll wire up the new prop and add the media-controls for each state.
•  Tag/Tag.mdx: the readOnly variant reuses the Tag style (1 px border, 12 px radius, padding/margins), so we need to reference and possibly extend these styles.
•  TextInput/TextInput.mdx: the placeholder, text-color, and icon colors ($text-placeholder, $icon-disabled) come from TextInput’s design tokens, so we need to ensure the readOnly MultiSelect applies the correct TextInput token values.
1.bug_scenario: The bug report calls out a new “read-only” variant of the MultiSelect (i.e., a dropdown with multi-select tags) that uses the same spacing and structure but with a transparent background, a strong border, disabled placeholder/icon colors, and non-interactive tags (rounded with a 1 px border and the specified padding/margins). The two design-spec images show: the base and filled states (no options selected vs. with selected tags), the precise padding (16 px, 8 px/4 px for tag content), border (1 px, $border-strong-01), typography ($text-placeholder, $text-secondary, $text-primary), icon color ($icon-disabled), and tag shape (12 px radius). This variant needs a readOnly prop, new styles, controls in the playground, a story, and RTL tests.
